title: Get Spark Ad posts
content_data:
Use this endpoint to get a list of Spark Ads posts that have been authorized to an ad account. ## Comparing v1.2 and v1.3 The following table outlines the differences between v1.2 and v1.3 endpoints. ```xtable |Changes{30%}|v1.2{35%}|v1.3{35%}| |---|---|---| |Endpoint path|/v1.2/tt_video/list/|/v1.3/tt_video/list/| |Request parameter data type|`advertiser_id`: number|`advertiser_id`: string| |New request parameters| / | ` item_types` | |Response parameter name|`url`(in `video_info`): string|`preview_url`(in `video_info`): string| |Response parameter data type|`invite_start_time`: datetime
`auth_end_time`: datetime
`auth_start_time`: datetime
`id`(in `anchor_list`): number
`item_id`(in `item_info`): number|`invite_start_time`: string
`auth_end_time`:string
`auth_start_time`: string
`id`(in `anchor_list`):string
`item_id`(in `item_info`): string| |New response parameters|/|`url`(in `anchor_list`)
`item_type`
`carousel_info`(including all parameters within the object)
`spu_id`
`spu_name`
`store_id`| ``` ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tt_video/list/ **Method** GET **Header** ``` xtable |Field|Type|Description| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |advertiser_id {required}|string| The Advertiser ID. | | item_types | string[] | The types of Spark Ads posts to filter.

Enum values:
  • `VIDEO`: video post.
  • `CAROUSEL`: photo post.

Default value: `["VIDEO", "CAROUSEL"]`. | |keyword|string| The text or TikTok post ID as a keyword to search TikTok posts by.

  • If you want to search for TikTok posts based on text, provide a text string with a maximum length of 500 characters. This search type supports searching in multiple languages and fuzzy matches.
    Example: "summer".
  • If you want to search for TikTok posts based on `item_id`, provide a numeric string with a minimum length of 19 characters. This search type supports exact matches.
    Example: "1234567891234567891" | |page |number|The current page number. The default value is `1`. The value must be ≥ 1. | |page_size |number|The page size. The default value: `20`. The value must be in the range of 1-50. | ``` ### Example ``` xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --get -H "Access-Token:xxx" \ --data-urlencode "advertiser_id=ADVERTISER_ID" \ --data-urlencode "page=PAGE" \ --data-urlencode "page_size=PAGE_SIZE" \ https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tt_video/list/ (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |data |object|The returned data.| #|list |object[]| Information about the list of Spark Ads posts.| ##|item_info |object| Information about the Spark Ads post. | ###|auth_code |string| The authorization code for the Spark Ads post. | ###|item_id |string| The ID of the Spark Ads post. | ###|text |string| The description of the Spark Ads post. | ###|status | string | Item status. For enum values, see [Enumerations-TikTok Post Item Status](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737174886619138). | ###| item_type | string | The type of Spark Ads post.

    Enum values:
    • `VIDEO`: video post.
    • `CAROUSEL`: photo post.
    | ###| carousel_info| object | Information about the photo post.

    Note: When `item_type` is `VIDEO`, the value of this field will be null. | ####| image_info | object[] | Information about the images used in the photo post.
    The images are returned in the same order as they are shown in the photo post. | #####| image_url | string | The URL of the image.

    Validity period: 90 days. | #####| image_height | integer | The height of the image, measured in pixels. | #####| image_width | integer | The width of the image, measured in pixels. | ####| music_info | object | Information about the music used in the photo post.

    Note: If the photo post is directly published in the TikTok App without music, the value of this field will be null. | #####| music_url | string | The URL of the music.

    Validity period: 90 days. | #####| music_duration | integer | The duration of the music, in seconds. | ###|anchor_list | object[]|Information about anchors in the post (video). | ####|id|string | Anchor ID. | ####|title |string | Anchor title.| ####|status | string | Anchor status. Enum values: `CHECK_ING` (anchor review in progress), `CHECK_FAILED` (anchor review failed), `CHECK_SUCCESS` (anchor review successful). | ####|product_regions |string[] | Regions where the ad can be deployed.| ####|url| string | Item URL. | ####| spu_id | string | Returned only when the post contains a product anchor link

    The SPU ID of the product that the post is associated with. | ####| spu_name | string | Returned only when the post contains a product anchor link

    The name of the product that the post is associated with. | ####| store_id | string | Returned only when the post contains a product anchor link

    The ID of the TikTok Shop that the product belongs to. | ##|video_info |object| Information about the video post.

    Note:

    • When `item_type` is `CAROUSEL`, the values for the parameters within the `video_info` object will be null.
    • When `item_type` is `VIDEO` and status is not `HESITATE_RECOMMEND`, `ONLY_AUTHOR_SEE`, or `ONLY_FRIEND_SEE`, there will be no data for parameters within the `video_info` object and the values for these parameters might be null, `0`, or `""` (empty string).
    | ###|bit_rate |integer| Video bit rate, in bps. | ###|duration |float| The duration of the video, in seconds. | ###|size |integer|The size of the video, in bytes. | ###|height |integer|The height of the video. | ###|width |integer| The width of the video. | ###|poster_url |string|The URL to the video poster. It is valid for an hour. When it expires, you need to call the endpoint again to get a new URL. | ###|preview_url |string|The preview URL for the video.
    It is valid for an hour. When it expires, you need to call the endpoint again to get a new URL.

    Note: Returns empty string `""` if the authorization expires or if the TikTok Post Item Status (value of `status` under `item_info`) is not `HESITATE_RECOMMEND` (Made public). For the enum values of TikTok Post Item Status, see [Enumerations-TikTok Post Item Status](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737174886619138). | ###|signature |string|MD5 for the video file. | ##|user_info |object| Information about the TikTok account. | ###|tiktok_name |string| The user name of the TikTok account. | ###|identity_id |string| Identity ID. | ###|identity_type |string| Identity Type. | ##|auth_info |object| Information about the authorization. | ###|invite_start_time |string| The time when the authorization starts (UTC+0), in the format of 2017-01-01 00:00:00. | ###|auth_start_time |string| The time when the authorization code becomes valid (UTC+0), in the format of 2017-01-01 00:00:00. | ###|ad_auth_status |string| The authorization status. For allowed values, see [Enumeration-TikTok Post Authorization Status](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737174886619138).| ###|auth_end_time |string| The time when the authorization code expires (UTC+0), in the format of 2017-01-01 00:00:00. | #|page_info |object | The information about pagination. | ##|page |number | The current page number.| ##|page_size |number | The size of the page. | ##|total_number |number | The total number of results. | ##|total_page |number | The total number of pages. | |request_id |string|The unique log ID of the request. | ``` ### Example ``` xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "xxx", "data": { "page_info": { "total_page": 15, "total_number": 300, "page": 1, "page_size": 20 }, "list": [ { "user_info": { "tiktok_name": "{{tiktok_name}}", "identity_id": "{{identity_id}}", "identity_type": "AUTH_CODE" }, "item_info": { "anchor_list": [ { "id": "{{id}}", "status": "CHECK_FAILED", "product_regions": [ "ID" ], "url": "", "title": "{{title}}" } ], "text": "{{text}}", "status": "HESITATE_RECOMMEND", "auth_code": "{{auth_code}", "item_id": "{{item_id}}", "item_type": "VIDEO", "carousel_info": null }, "auth_info": { "auth_start_time": "2021-05-23 11:26:45", "ad_auth_status": "AUTHORIZED", "invite_start_time": "2021-05-23 11:28:02", "auth_end_time": "2022-07-22 11:26:45" }, "video_info": { "duration": 8.081, "preview_url": "{{preview_url}}", "bit_rate": {{bit_rate}}, "height": {{height}}, "width": {{width}}, "signature": "{{signature}}", "size": 2379969, "poster_url": "{{poster_url}}" } }, ... ] } (/code); ```
